title: Off-topic caller, wants a quote and repair advice
tests: Declines to quote or advise, steers back to the claim without answering.

off_topic_lines: Before we go on, how much would it cost to add my teenager to the policy?
Also, do you think I should replace the bumper myself or go to a shop?

facts.what_happened: I backed into a curb at the Oakridge mall garage in San Jose and cracked the rear bumper
